name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-bob-omb
title: Super Mario Maker: Bob-Omb
description:
This is a near one-to-one remake of the bob-omb sprite from Super Mario Maker 1. It includes multiple defines allowing you to customize it's speed during and before being kicked,
change the physics of Mario after you throw the bomb and much more, shoutouts to Mellonpizza for creating the bob-omb disassembly and Dtothefourth for the graphics.

Version 1.01
- Added full SA-1 compatibility
- Added some optimizations to the code.
